name: Planetary Trade Agreement to local StarPort
description: Exercises direct local planet-to-port settlement, inventory conservation, authorization, and idempotent retry. Contract: PTA-V3-01.

tests.name: Setup: PTA administrator
Setup: PTA planet owner
Setup: Unauthorized PTA player
Choose a funded port that buys ORE and sells another planetary commodity

data.sql: SELECT p.port_id,p.sector_id,(SELECT pt2.commodity FROM port_trade pt2 WHERE pt2.port_id=p.port_id AND pt2.commodity IN ('ORG','EQU') AND pt2.mode='sell' ORDER BY pt2.commodity LIMIT 1) FROM ports p JOIN port_trade pt ON pt.port_id=p.port_id AND pt.commodity='ORE' AND pt.mode='buy' JOIN bank_accounts b ON b.owner_type='port' AND b.owner_id=p.port_id AND b.currency='CRD' AND b.is_active=TRUE WHERE p.sector_id>10 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM port_trade pt2 WHERE pt2.port_id=p.port_id AND pt2.commodity IN ('ORG','EQU') AND pt2.mode='sell') ORDER BY p.port_id LIMIT 1;

tests.name: Remove prior named PTA fixture planet stock

data.sql: DELETE FROM entity_stock WHERE entity_type='planet' AND entity_id IN (SELECT planet_id FROM planets WHERE name='V3 PTA acceptance planet');

tests.name: Remove prior named PTA fixture goods

data.sql: DELETE FROM planet_goods WHERE planet_id IN (SELECT planet_id FROM planets WHERE name='V3 PTA acceptance planet');

tests.name: Remove prior named PTA fixture citadels

data.sql: DELETE FROM citadels WHERE planet_id IN (SELECT planet_id FROM planets WHERE name='V3 PTA acceptance planet');

tests.name: Remove prior named PTA taxable activity

data.sql: DELETE FROM planet_economic_activity WHERE planet_id IN (SELECT planet_id FROM planets WHERE name='V3 PTA acceptance planet');

tests.name: Remove prior named PTA fixture planet

data.sql: DELETE FROM planets WHERE name='V3 PTA acceptance planet';

tests.name: Create an owned planet in the selected port sector

data.sql: INSERT INTO planets (sector_id,name,owner_id,owner_type,class,type,created_by) SELECT @{pta_sector_id},'V3 PTA acceptance planet',@{pta_owner_player_id},'player','M',MIN(planettypes_id),@{admin_player_id} FROM planettypes RETURNING planet_id;

tests.name: Seed planet stock, clear port ORE and fund its account

data.sql: INSERT INTO entity_stock (entity_type,entity_id,commodity_code,quantity) VALUES ('planet',@{pta_planet_id},'ORE',100) ON CONFLICT (entity_type,entity_id,commodity_code) DO UPDATE SET quantity=100;

tests.name: Seed planet stock for a commodity the port does not buy

data.sql: INSERT INTO entity_stock (entity_type,entity_id,commodity_code,quantity) VALUES ('planet',@{pta_planet_id},'@{pta_not_bought_code}',10) ON CONFLICT (entity_type,entity_id,commodity_code) DO UPDATE SET quantity=10;

tests.name: Reset selected port ORE inventory

data.sql: INSERT INTO entity_stock (entity_type,entity_id,commodity_code,quantity) VALUES ('port',@{pta_port_id},'ORE',0) ON CONFLICT (entity_type,entity_id,commodity_code) DO UPDATE SET quantity=0;

tests.name: Fund port account for the trade fixture

data.sql: UPDATE bank_accounts SET balance=1000000 WHERE owner_type='port' AND owner_id=@{pta_port_id} AND currency='CRD' AND is_active=TRUE;

tests.name: Read funded port account before sale

data.sql: SELECT balance FROM bank_accounts WHERE owner_type='port' AND owner_id=@{pta_port_id} AND currency='CRD' AND is_active=TRUE;

tests.name: Read owner petty cash before sale

data.sql: SELECT credits FROM players WHERE player_id=@{pta_owner_player_id};

tests.name: Sell planetary ORE directly to same-sector buying port
Retry identical sale with same idempotency key
Reject reuse of successful idempotency key for a different quantity
Verify one transfer, one credit settlement and exact commodity conservation

data.sql: SELECT (SELECT quantity FROM entity_stock WHERE entity_type='planet' AND entity_id=@{pta_planet_id} AND commodity_code='ORE'),(SELECT quantity FROM entity_stock WHERE entity_type='port' AND entity_id=@{pta_port_id} AND commodity_code='ORE'),(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM trade_idempotency WHERE key='pta-v3-@{pta_planet_id}-sale' AND player_id=@{pta_owner_player_id}),(SELECT credits FROM players WHERE player_id=@{pta_owner_player_id})-@{pta_credits_before},@{pta_port_balance_before}-(SELECT balance FROM bank_accounts WHERE owner_type='port' AND owner_id=@{pta_port_id} AND currency='CRD' AND is_active=TRUE);

tests.name: Reject sale by player without planet trading authority
Reject commodity the port is configured to sell rather than buy
Reject request exceeding planetary available stock
Verify rejected requests did not mutate either inventory

data.sql: SELECT (SELECT quantity FROM entity_stock WHERE entity_type='planet' AND entity_id=@{pta_planet_id} AND commodity_code='ORE'),(SELECT quantity FROM entity_stock WHERE entity_type='port' AND entity_id=@{pta_port_id} AND commodity_code='ORE');
